reviews.comment: He is an easy going guy and all slides are on ecampus. He randomly takes attendance quizzes. He is very smart and knows a lot, but the lectures can be a little dull. Tests are fairly straightforward. Not my first pick for prof, but he's not bad either.

Dr. Cook is very smart, and is pretty good at making the course content clear. Not the best professor I've had, but not the worst. I'd probably take him again. Tests are fairly simple if you study, and he's a nice guy who's usually pretty relaxed. Lectures are kinda boring and there are pop quizzes, but he posts everything to eCampus. Not bad.

This man is a nightmare. It's very clear that he doesn't want to be teaching, and he's terrible at explaining what he is doing. It's a very math-heavy class, so confusion is understandable, but he doesn't make any attempt to slow down or catch people up. I  will say that he gives out decent test reviews prior to exams, but don't expect to learn.
